name: UI Patterns Entity Links
description: Exposes entity link templates (canonical, edit, delete...) as Layout Builder blocks rendered via UI Patterns components.
project_description:
Expose entity links as Layout Builder blocks and display them using UI Patterns components.

 Entity Links are an array of standard link relations to the URI template that should be used for them, like "canonical", "edit-form"...

 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 UI Patterns : Define and expose self-contained UI patterns as Drupal plugins and use them seamlessly while site-building.

 
 UI Patterns 1.x only 
 UI Patterns 2, a rewrite of UI Patterns upon Drupal Core's SDC, has its own implementation of entity links.

 
 Back to top 

 Installation 
 Install as you would normally install a contributed Drupal module. Visit https://www.drupal.org/node/1897420 for further information.

 The module has no menu or modifiable settings.

 Back to top
